europe_now.title: Escalating Protests and Security Incidents in France
europe_now.summary: Mass student demonstrations and strikes have expanded across France following days of violent clashes, leading to significant disruption and a serious injury during a confrontation with police. Political figures have doubled down on the protests as authorities face widespread public unrest.

europe_now.summary: Ukrainian drone operations struck Moscow in one of the largest attacks of its kind in two years, escalating aerial hostilities. The strikes have caused heightened fear and transport disruptions for rail passengers.

top_stories.title: Regional Defense Preparations in Poland and Lithuania
top_stories.summary: Poland and Lithuania are making formal logistical preparations to manage up to one million Baltic refugees. These contingency plans are being put in place specifically for a potential outbreak of war in the region.

top_stories.title: Espionage Arrest In Germany
top_stories.summary: Law enforcement authorities have arrested a former German spy chief on charges of treason and espionage. The high-profile detention involves sensitive national security implications within the country's intelligence apparatus.
